co.title: Habrá clases virtuales en el Tolima tras el sismo: en estos municipios
co.description: Habrá clases virtuales en el Tolima tras el sismo: en estos municipios jferreira Mar, 03/11/2026 - 06:44 Fecha nodo Image /sites/default/files/imagenes/2026/11/habra-clases-virtuales-en-el-tolima-tras-el-sismo-en-estos-municipios.webp Body Los estudiantes de los colegios oficiales de Ibagué y los 46 municipios del Tolima no tendrán clases presenciales este martes 3 de noviembre, luego del sismo de magnitud 5,6 registrado durante la madrugada, con epicentro en Chaparral. Puede leer: Un fuerte sismo sacudió al Tolima este martes: se sintió gran en parte del país La decisión busca permitir que las autoridades revisen las condiciones de las sedes educativas y descarten posibles daños en sus estructuras antes de retomar las actividades habituales. Mientras se realizan las inspecciones, los alumnos desarrollarán su jornada académica desde casa. Así funcionará la jornada escolar en el Tolima La Secretaría de Educación del departamento activó la estrategia Escuela en Casa. La medida se puso en marcha desde las primeras horas de la mañana, luego de las indicaciones de la gobernadora Adriana Magali Matiz y la coordinación con los rectores de las instituciones oficiales. La administración departamental informó que durante este martes evaluará si es necesario mantener la suspensión presencial en algunas sedes durante los próximos días. Revisarán colegios en municipios afectados Como parte de la respuesta, se activó el Comité de Gestión del Riesgo Escolar para verificar las condiciones de los establecimientos educativos, especialmente en Chaparral, San Antonio y Cajamarca, donde se adelantarán inspecciones para identificar posibles afectaciones. Los resultados de esas revisiones permitirán definir si existen condiciones para regresar a las aulas o si deben mantenerse las actividades desde casa. Ibagué también tendrá clases virtuales En la capital tolimense, la alcaldesa Johana Aranda anunció que las instituciones educativas oficiales trabajarán de manera virtual mientras se revisan sus instalaciones. Por ahora, la suspensión de clases presenciales corresponde a este martes 3 de noviembre. co.title: Luto en España: Murió Jesús De Miguel, el delantero de Tenerife, tras duro choque con el arquero
co.description: El delantero del Tenerife Jesús De Miguel, de 30 años, murió tras el golpe que sufrió con un contrario el lunes en un partido de la Segunda División española contra el Andorra. “Rotos de dolor, con un nudo en la garganta y sin poder creer que esto sea verdad, desde el CD Tenerife comunicamos el trágico fallecimiento” a las 7:00 horas, de De Miguel, ingresado de urgencia el lunes tras chocar con el portero de Andorra, Jesús Owono. El golpe que acabó con De Miguel en la Unidad de Cuidados Intensivos del Hospital Universitario Nuestra Señora de Candelaria de Tenerife se produjo en los últimos minutos del encuentro entre el Tenerife y el Andorra. De Miguel se disponía a controlar un balón en el centro del campo cuando Owono salió a intentar despejar la pelota, arrollando al delantero rival en una imagen que dejó en silencio al estadio Heliodoro Rodríguez López. El árbitro reflejó en el acta que Owono, al que expulsó, había impactado con la pierna en alto en De Miguel. El jugador del Tenerife quedó tendido en el suelo, donde fue atendido por las asistencias. Según la prensa española, el futbolista sufrió una parada cardiorrespiratoria tras el golpe, de la que pudo ser reanimado. El árbitro suspendió el encuentro y De Miguel fue evacuado en ambulancia al hospital, donde quedó ingresado. En un principio, se había informado de que se encontraba “estable dentro de la gravedad”, aunque comunicado otro a última hora de la madrugada del martes apuntaba a que había “empeorado neurológicamente”. “No hay palabras de consuelo; no hay absolutamente nada que mitigue este sentimiento repleto de tristeza”, expresó el Tenerife en su comunicado, difundido en redes sociales sobre una foto del jugador en blanco y negro. “Estamos junto a su desolada familia, junto a sus seres queridos, junto a todo el tinerfeñismo que hoy llora por este cruel desenlace”, añadió el club canario. “La familia de Jesús de Miguel agradece todas y cada una de las muestras de apoyo recibidas, e igualmente solicita, de corazón, máximo respeto a su privacidad, en estos terribles momentos”, concluye la nota del conjunto tinerfeño. De Miguel llevaba algo más de una temporada en el Tenerife, al que había llegado en el verano de 2025 procedente del Castellón. Nada más conocerse la noticia de su fallecimiento, los mensajes de pésame se han sucedido, empezando por el Andorra. “Con el corazón roto y devastados, queremos mandar nuestro más sincero pésame a la familia de Jesús de Miguel, a todos sus compañeros, amigos y al CD Tenerife”, afirmó el club andorrano en un mensaje en sus redes sociales. “Lo siento con toda mi alma. Descansa en paz Jesús”, escribió en la red X el exfutbolista Gerard Piqué, máximo accionista del Andorra. Real Madrid, Barcelona, Atlético de Madrid y varios otros clubes se han unido al luto por el fallecimiento del jugador del Tenerife. La Federación Española ha aplazado los partidos de Copa del Rey y de Copa de la Reina que debían celebrarse este martes como señal de respeto. “La gran familia del fútbol español permanece unida en el dolor por esta triste pérdida y traslada todo su cariño y apoyo a los familiares, amigos y seres queridos de Jesús de Miguel”, afirmó la RFEF en un comunicado. Las muestras de condolencias también han llegado desde otros ámbitos de la sociedad y política españolas. in.title: TRAI releases new telecom interconnection rules, to kick in from Jan 1
in.description: New Delhi, November 3 (IANS): The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) on Tuesday released “The Telecommunication Interconnection (Third Amendment) Regulations, 2026” which will come into effect from January 1, 2027. Interconnection in telecommunications refers to the technical, operational, and commercial arrangements that connect two or more telecom networks, allowing telecommunications traffic to flow between them and enabling users of different service providers to communicate seamlessly, according to an official statement. The amendment modernises the existing interconnection regulatory framework to align with contemporary network architectures and facilitate a transition from the existing interconnection at Long Distance Charging Area (LDCA) and Short Distance Charging Area (SDCA) level to the Licensed Service Area (LSA) level of interconnection. The shifting of traffic to LSA-level POIs would simplify routing and support more efficient management of scarce numbering resources, and would also result in benefits such as lower latency, and enhanced service reliability, according to the official statement. Existing traffic, in terms of Minutes of Usage (MoUs), at the LDCA/SDCA-level points of interconnection (POIs) will be migrated to LSA-level POIs within three years, in a phased manner. Thereafter, all traffic will be handed over or taken over at the LSA or Service Area level POIs. The amendment regulations provide for establishment of IP-based interconnection by service providers. All new interconnections established after these regulations come into force will be IP-based interconnections. All existing POIs working on E1/TDM-based interconnection will be migrated to IP-based interconnection within a period of three years, in a phased manner. The migration to IP-based interconnection improves bandwidth efficiency, call quality and end-to-end call performance. For IP-based interconnection, maximum call-handling capacity at a POI would be determined having regard to the concurrent session-handling capability and link bandwidth, while maintaining the desired Quality of Service in accordance with the TRAI’s relevant Regulations. A specific regulatory framework has been introduced for the surrender of POIs. Earlier, the regulations had only the provision of “disconnection” of a POI, which is for stoppage of exchange of traffic at the POI. This is a step taken by a service provider for reasons attributable to the other service provider, in exceptional circumstances arising out of differences between them. On the other hand, the process for surrender is intended for voluntary surrender of a POI by a service provider for its own operational requirements, such as on account of reduction in traffic, withdrawal of services from an area or re-routing of traffic, thereby improving financial efficiency. The existing bank guarantee framework has been retained; however, the validity of bank guarantees furnished on reassessment, and the interval for such reassessment, have been extended from six months to 12 months. A revised methodology has also been introduced for determining the ceiling on bank guarantees for POIs, including IP-based interconnection. A specific provision has been introduced to address delayed payment of interconnection charges or interconnection usage charges. The rate of interest shall be mutually agreed between service providers, subject to a ceiling of the State Bank of India’s one-year Marginal Cost of Funds-based Lending Rate (MCLR) plus two percent. The amendment regulations prescribe reporting requirements for monitoring the shifting of traffic from LDCA/SDCA-level POIs to LSA-level POIs, and migration from E1/TDM-based to IP-based interconnection. For effective implementation of the regulations, a graded financial disincentive framework has been prescribed for contravention of provisions of these regulations. This revision makes the enforcement of the regulatory framework more effective, proportionate and commensurate with the nature and seriousness of the contraventions covered under these Regulations. The provisions for interest on delayed payment, reporting requirements, and financial disincentives will enable effective enforcement of the regulations.

sg.description: Mutsamudu, Comoros, November 3, 2026 – MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, announced an upgrade to Futures Earn. This product helps retail traders use their capital more efficiently by allowing eligible futures account balances to earn interest while users continue trading. The upgrade is designed to improve the overall user experience and make the product easier to understand and use. Futures Earn Upgrade Highlights Futures Earn involves several aspects, including interest calculation rules and reward calculation. To help users better understand and navigate Futures Earn throughout their user journey, MEXC has made three key improvements to the user experience. Visualized Reward Rules: The core logic behind reward calculations is now presented through diagrams, making it easier for users to understand how earnings are calculated. Scenario-Based Guidance: Users receive timely, in-context guidance at key stages of the user journey, from activating Futures Earn and depositing funds to earning interest on open positions. Earnings Calculator: Users can customize parameters to estimate potential earnings, making it easier to understand and assess expected returns before using the product. Innovative Interest Mechanism, Up to 20% APR Futures Earn introduces an innovative way to put trading capital to work, built around the idea that “Your Futures Balance Earns Too.” By integrating an interest-earning mechanism directly into the futures account, it allows eligible balances to automatically generate interest while remaining available for futures trading. Users do not need to choose between trading and earning, transfer funds out of their futures account, or subscribe to a separate earning product. Dedicated futures earning products remain relatively uncommon across the industry. Among the offerings currently available, some are limited to a single stablecoin, require minimum trading volumes, or operate as time-limited campaigns. MEXC Futures Earn combines broader asset coverage, higher earning potential, and lower barriers to participation. It supports eligible USDT- and USDE-margined futures pairs, with no minimum trading volume requirement or fixed end date. USDT-margined pairs offer a 5% base APR plus up to 15% in additional rewards, bringing the maximum APR to 20%, while USDE-margined pairs offer a 4.75% base APR. Eligible futures account balances of at least 100 USDT automatically accrue interest hourly, with rewards settled daily, while remaining available for trading. Making Capital Efficiency More Accessible Institutional market participants have long prioritized capital efficiency and typically have access to more sophisticated tools for managing and deploying capital. MEXC believes retail traders should also have greater opportunities to improve how they use their funds. MEXC remains committed to putting retail traders at the heart of its product and service development, offering innovative products and services such as 0-fee trading, deep liquidity, exclusive VVIP benefits, and Futures Earn to optimize trading costs, trade execution, and capital utilization. Looking ahead, MEXC will continue to break down barriers and empower more retail traders to achieve greater capital efficiency and unlock more value from their capital. To learn more about MEXC Futures Earn, visit the official product page. About MEXC Founded in 2018, MEXC is a leading global multi-asset trading platform built as your 0-fee gateway to infinite opportunities. Serving users across 170+ markets, MEXC provides simple and efficient access to crypto, stocks, tokenized assets, derivatives, and a growing range of TradFi-linked opportunities through one account and one gateway. With 0 trading fees, deep liquidity, broad asset coverage, and a high-performance trading experience, MEXC is designed for retail users who want to discover earlier, act faster, and trade with fewer barriers. As crypto and traditional finance continue to converge, MEXC is committed to making global opportunities more accessible, helping users trade freely and MEXCmize every opportunity. bd.title: World Laureates Forum 2026 Opens with Award Ceremony of the WLF Prize and Main Forum----Leading Scientists Explore "Break Through for the Next Decade"
bd.description: SHANGHAI, Nov. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- A news report from YICAI: On the morning of October 31, the opening ceremony of the World Laureates Forum 2026 and the award ceremony of the WLF Prize, together with its main forum, were held at the Shanghai Lingang Center, the permanent venue of the World Laureates Forum. Under the theme "New Science Paradigm: Break Through for the Next Decade," this year's forum focused on four key areas: new paradigms for collaborative research enabled by artificial intelligence; new value-creation pathways for scientific discovery; new models of international cooperation built on openness and trust; and new approaches to developing the capabilities of young scientists. Nearly 300 scientists from China and abroad, along with more than 4,000 other guests, engaged in in-depth discussions and gathered consensus on major issues shaping the future of science, including research paradigms, value chains, international cooperation, talent development, and science and technology governance. 01 A Constellation of Scientific Excellence: World-Class Scientists Receive Top Honors At the award ceremony, eleven scientists were honored in three categories: the 2026 WLF Prize in Computer Science or Mathematics, the 2026 WLF Prize in Life Science or Medicine, and the newly established 2026 WLF Prize for Young Scientists. Established in Shanghai in 2021, the World Laureates Foundation Prize (WLF Prize) is an international science award initiated and administered by the World Laureates Foundation. The prize is exclusively funded by HongShan China, with support from the Shanghai Lingang Science and Technology Innovation Development Foundation. The WLF Prize has two established categories: Computer Science or Mathematics and Life Science or Medicine. Each category carries a total prize of 10 million yuan, which may be shared by up to four recipients. Newly introduced this year, the WLF Prize for Young Scientists recognizes outstanding early-career researchers worldwide. Six recipients are selected annually, each receiving 1 million yuan. With this year's selection marking its fifth edition, the WLF Prize has honored a total of 23 scientists. It has become an internationally recognized scientific award with broad influence among the world's leading scientific community. 2000 Turing Award laureate Andrew Chi-Chih YAO announced that Ingrid DAUBECHIES, James B. Duke Distinguished Professor Emerita of Mathematics at Duke University, had received the 2026 WLF Prize in Computer Science or Mathematics. The citation read: "For major contributions in applied harmonic analysis, wavelet theory, and image compression, and for leadership in the international mathematics community." Stanford University Professor of Biology and Neurobiology Liqun LUO announced the four recipients of the 2026 WLF Prize in Life Science or Medicine: YUAN Junying, Director and Principal Investigator of the Interdisciplinary Research Center on Biology and Chemistry at the Shanghai Institute of Organic Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS); WANG Xiaodong, Director and Investigator at the National Institute of Biological Sciences (NIBS), Beijing; SHAO Feng, Deputy Director and Investigator at NIBS, Beijing; and Vishva DIXIT of Genentech, Inc. in the United States. The citation read: "These four scientists elucidated the molecular pathways of distinct forms of programmed cell death, which govern diverse physiological functions and disease pathogenesis. Their pioneering discoveries transformed programmed cell death from a set of observed biological phenomena into precisely defined molecular pathways, established the biochemical basis of apoptosis, and profoundly reshaped research in fields such as cancer biology and neurodegeneration." 1994 Fields Medalist Efim ZELMANOV announced the six recipients of the inaugural WLF Prize for Young Scientists, introduced this year. The six awardees are Raphaële Juliette CLÉMENT, Director of the Department of Electrochemical Materials at the Max Planck Institute for Solid State Research and Associate Professor in the Materials Department at the University of California, Santa Barbara; CHEN Peining, a tenured professor and doctoral advisor at Fudan University; DING Shiqian, an associate professor at Tsinghua University; WU Jiajun, an assistant professor of computer science at Stanford University; XIE Weidi, an associate professor at the School of Artificial Intelligence at Shanghai Jiao Tong University; and ZHUANG Ziquan, an assistant professor in the Department of Mathematics at Johns Hopkins University. Randy W. SCHEKMAN, 2013 Nobel Prize laureate in Physiology or Medicine and Chair of the WLF Prize Selection Committee in Life Science or Medicine, joined the three award announcers in presenting the awards to the recipients. Michael LEVITT, 2013 Nobel Prize laureate in Chemistry, delivered the concluding remarks at the award ceremony. 02 Intellectual Exchange: Scientists and Industry Leaders Join Forces to Explore Technological Transformation Leading scientists from China and abroad, together with prominent figures from industry, delivered a series of keynote speeches, sharing the latest advances and insights from frontier scientific research and industrial practice. Their discussions helped bridge the gap between basic research and industrial innovation and fostered collaboration in addressing scientific challenges faced by humanity. Omar M. YAGHI, 2025 Nobel Prize laureate in Chemistry and Xinghua Distinguished Chair Professor in the Department of Chemistry and the Department of Chemical Engineering at Tsinghua University, delivered a keynote speech titled "Selection Science for AI and Humanity." HU Hailan, Member of CAS and Dean of the School of Brain Science and Brain Medicine at Zhejiang University, delivered a keynote speech titled "From 'The Strong Get Stronger' to Ketamine: The Brain Mechanisms of Social Behavior and Emotion." ZENG Yuqun, Founder and Chairman of Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Limited (CATL), delivered a keynote speech titled "Innovation-Driven Sustainable Energy: Building a Better Future for Humanity Together." Laurent LAFFORGUE, 2002 Fields Medalist and Senior Expert at Huawei France, delivered a keynote speech titled "Mathematicians Facing the Success of Large Language Models: Is There a 'Space of Texts'?" TANG Jie, Professor at Tsinghua University and Founder of Z.ai, delivered a keynote speech titled "From Chatbots to Scaling Up: A New Era of Development in Large Language Models." This year's forum adopted an overall "1+6+4+1" framework: one combined opening ceremony, award ceremony, and main forum; six parallel forums; four themed events; and one closing ceremony. The six parallel forums focused on six emerging and frontier fields: future semiconductors, biomedicine, aerospace information, artificial intelligence, future energy, and quantum science. They were organized respectively by Shanghai University, Lingang Laboratory, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, East China Normal University, Fudan University, and Tongji University, in collaboration with national academic societies and leading companies. By strategically integrating the academic strengths and research resources of universities into the forum program, the organizers brought together leading scientific and research resources with greater efficiency and fostered the exchange and cross-fertilization of cutting-edge ideas. In addition, the forum featured four major themed events: the Young Scientists Forum, the SHE Forum, the Future Scientists Forum, and the World Top-Performing Incubator Conference. A series of distinctive side events was also organized, including four science and technology tours, the WLF HUB, WLF Prize Campus Visits, and a temporary exhibition titled "Liu Hui: The Great Mathematician of Ancient China" held in Shanghai. By fully leveraging Shanghai's rich local resources in science and technology innovation, these initiatives created a multifaceted platform for exchange, with parallel forums deepening dialogue, themed events fostering talent development and innovation, and supporting activities translating ideas into action. 03 Looking Ahead: Joining Forces to Explore Scientific Breakthroughs Over the Next Decade Since its inception in 2018, the World Laureates Forum has remained committed to its guiding vision of "Science and Technology for the Common Destiny of Mankind" and upheld three core missions: advancing fundamental science, promoting international cooperation, and supporting the development of young scientists. It has become an important link connecting the world's leading scientists, a key bridge for high-level dialogue across the global scientific community, and an important platform for nurturing and advancing the next generation of scientific talent. This year's forum brought together 32 recipients of the world's most prestigious scientific honors, including the Nobel Prize, Turing Award, Wolf Prize, and Fields Medal. They were joined by 23 members of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and the Chinese Academy of Engineering, 139 senior scientists, 81 young scientists, and high-level scholars of Chinese descent, among other participants. Together, they formed a well-structured talent cohort. As the permanent home of the World Laureates Forum, the Lin-gang Special Area is both a key base for advancing the development of Shanghai as an international center for science and technology innovation and a strategic gateway for connecting with the world's leading scientific minds. Leveraging the opportunity presented by this prestigious international scientific gathering, the Lin-gang Special Area will accelerate the development of Lin-gang Science and Innovation City, with a focus on translating world-class scientific resources into new drivers of innovation. It aims to become an important base for attracting talent from China and abroad to advance international innovation collaboration; a key hub for coordinating the development of onshore and offshore businesses; a major springboard for companies seeking to go global and grow their businesses; an important channel for making better use of both domestic and international markets and resources; and a pioneering testing ground for participation in international economic governance. The 2026 World Laureates Forum was hosted by the China Association for Science and Technology (CAST) and organized by the China Center for International Science and Technology Exchange (CISTE), the Shanghai Association for Science and Technology (SAST), the Shenzhen Pengrui Public Welfare Foundation, the HongShan Charity Foundation, and the World Laureates Foundation.

He said the flag represents the UAE’s journey of ambition, determination and achievement, which has made the country a global model of development and prosperity. Every new achievement, he noted, further strengthens the UAE flag’s standing and the respect it commands around the world. His Highness said that under the leadership of His Highness Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, President of the UAE, and His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Vice President and Prime Minister of the UAE and Ruler of Dubai, and with the support of Their Highnesses the Supreme Council Members and Rulers of the Emirates, the UAE continues to invest in its people and pursue ambitious development goals, guided by its national values and a vision for a more prosperous, sustainable and competitive future. Sheikh Ahmed also emphasised that safeguarding the UAE’s achievements requires dedication, innovation and preparing future generations to build on the nation’s progress. He praised the UAE’s people for turning ambitions into achievements and unlocking new opportunities to strengthen the nation’s global standing and influence. sa.title: «فيفا» يسمح بالاطلاع على وثائق المشروع التجاري
sa.description: سمح الاتحاد الدولي لكرة القدم «فيفا» لأعضاء مجلسه بالاطلاع على «الوثائق الرئيسة» المتعلِّقة بمشروع الشركة التجارية، الذي كان مفتوحًا أمام مستثمرين من القطاع الخاص، وأُجهض في نهاية المطاف، وأثار أزمةً حادةً داخل الهيئة الكروية العالمية، حسبما أفاد به مصدرٌ مطلعٌ على الملف في وكالة فرانس برس، الثلاثاء. وقال المصدر: «أبلغ فيفا أعضاء مجلسه، بمَن فيهم جميع نواب الرئيس، أنهم سيتمكَّنون من الوصول إلى الوثائق الرئيسة المتعلِّقة بمشروع فيفا فوروارد إنتربرايز». وأوضح المصدر ذاته، أنه يتعيَّن على أعضاء المجلس الذين أُبلِغوا بالأمر عبر رسالةٍ، بعثها ماتياس جرافستروم، الأمين العام لـ «فيفا»، إبداء رغبتهم خلال الأسبوعين المقبلين للاطلاع على الوثائق شخصيًّا، ووفق شروطٍ محدَّدةٍ في مقر الاتحاد الدولي للعبة بزيوريخ في سويسرا. وتأتي مبادرة «فيفا» في وقتٍ لجأ فيه الاتحاد الأوروبي للعبة «يويفا»، الذي كان في طليعة المعارضين للمشروع، الذي تخلَّى عنه جياني إنفانتينو، رئيس الاتحاد الدولي، في نهاية المطاف بسبب موجة الاعتراضات، إلى القضاء في ولاية فلوريدا الأمريكية لإجبار الشركات التابعة لـ «فيفا» في الولايات المتحدة على تسليمه مجموعةً من الوثائق المرتبطة بهذا الملف تمهيدًا لاحتمال رفع دعوى أمام القضاء السويسري بتهمة سوء الإدارة. ومنذ الكشف عن المشروع، بعد كأس العالم 2026، دخل الاتحاد الأوروبي للعبة في مواجهةٍ مفتوحةٍ مع إنفانتينو، الذي يعتزم الترشُّح لخلافة نفسه مارس 2027، في حين يرغب الاتحاد الأوروبي في رحيله. كذلك وجَّه «يويفا» إلى «فيفا» سلسلةً من الأسئلة بشأن الحوكمة، ومنحه مهلة أسبوعين للرد عليها، وهي مهلة عدَّها الاتحاد الدولي غير واقعيةٍ. وبعد فترةٍ، تعرَّض خلالها لضغوطٍ كبيرةٍ، بات الطريق ممهدًا مجدَّدًا أمام إنفانتينو لإعادة انتخابه. ومع اقتراب الموعد النهائي لتقديم الترشيحات، 18 نوفمبر الجاري، لم ينجح «يويفا» حتى الآن في إيجاد شخصيةٍ ذات مصداقيةٍ لمنافسة المسؤول الإيطالي السويسري الذي يتولى المنصب منذ عام 2016، ويسعى إلى ولايةٍ رابعةٍ. وتلقَّى إنفانتينو دعمًا مهمًّا، 23 أكتوبر الماضي، عندما قرَّر الاتحاد الآسيوي للعبة الاصطفاف إلى جانبه. ويُعدُّ ذلك تحوُّلًا كبيرًا، إذ كان الاتحاد الآسيوي من بين المعارضين لإنفانتينو، إلى جانب «يويفا»، واتحاد أمريكا الشمالية والوسطى والكاريبي «كونكاكاف» عقب الكشف عن مشروع الشركة التجارية.

sa.description: a {text-decoration: none;color: #464feb;}tr th, tr td {border: 1px solid #e6e6e6;}tr th {background-color: #f5f5f5;}تحولت حياة متقاعد أسترالي إلى سلسلة من المواجهات اليومية غير المعتادة بعدما وجد نفسه هدفاً لملاحقة طائر إيمو ضخم منذ نحو تسعة أشهر، في وقت ترفض فيه السلطات التدخل لعدم وجود ما يثبت خطورة سلوكه.ووفق تقارير إعلامية أسترالية، يعيش مال ريتشاردز في منطقة بلوواتر شمال ولاية كوينزلاند حالة من القلق المستمر بسبب طائر إيمو يُعرف محلياً باسم (إريك)، الذي اعتاد الانتظار قرب منزله ومرافقته في تحركاته اليومية.ويقول ريتشاردز إن معاناته تبدأ قبل شروق الشمس تقريباً، إذ يُفاجأ بالطائر بالقرب من منزله كلما خرج لإحضار الصحيفة أو إنجاز أعماله اليومية في الحديقة، مشيراً إلى أن محاولاته المتكررة لإبعاده لم تحقق أي نتيجة.ولا تقتصر المشكلة، بحسب روايته، على مرافقة الطائر المستمرة له، بل تشمل الضوضاء التي يصدرها وفضلاته المتكررة داخل محيط المنزل، ما جعله يشعر بعدم الارتياح رغم أن الطائر لا يُظهر سلوكاً عدائياً مباشراً.ويخشى الرجل الاقتراب من الإيمو بسبب حجمه الكبير وقوة أرجله ومخالبه، خاصة أن هذا النوع من الطيور قادر على توجيه ركلات قوية قد تتسبب في إصابات إذا شعر بالخطر.ودفع استمرار الوضع المتقاعد الأسترالي إلى تقديم شكاوى لعددٍ من الجهات الرسمية؛ من بينها مجلس مدينة تاونسفيل والهيئات البيئية المختصة، إلا أن جميع المحاولات لم تسفر عن حل عملي.من جانبها، أكدت السلطات البيئية في كوينزلاند أن فرق الحياة الفطرية تتابع وضع الطائر، لكنها لم ترصد أي سلوك مقلق أو تهديد مباشر يبرر التدخل أو نقله من المنطقة، داعية السكان إلى عدم إطعامه وترك مسافة آمنة عند التعامل معه.وفي المقابل، يحظى (إريك) بشعبية واسعة بين سكان بلوواتر، الذين يتداولون صوره ومقاطع ظهوره بشكل متكرر على صفحات المجتمع المحلي، فيما يصفه كثيرون بأنه أحد أشهر الحيوانات في المنطقة.ويرى مختصون بالحياة البرية أن سبب اقتراب الطائر المتكرر من البشر يعود إلى تربيته سابقاً كحيوان أليف، الأمر الذي أفقده جانباً من السلوك الطبيعي المعتاد لدى طيور الإيمو البرية وجعله أكثر اعتياداً على وجود الناس.ورغم التطمينات الرسمية، لا يزال ريتشاردز يترقب ظهور زائره الثقيل كل صباح، بينما تستمر المطاردة الغريبة التي تحولت إلى حديث سكان المنطقة خلال الأشهر الماضية.
